answer: An AI-agent economy resists sybil attacks by forcing every new identity to lock a non-trivial stake of value that is permanently anchored to its on-chain history. An attacker who wants a swarm of fake agents must therefore fund an entire dune of such deposits up front; each additional head multiplies the capital at risk, and any misbehavior by a sybil can forfeit the ferrous-like hard stake, making mass identity farming economically ruinous rather than free.
